caption: The drawing depicts a single dress displayed without a body, centered on a plain, light beige background. The dress has a fitted bodice with a wide, slightly off-the-shoulder neckline and short sleeves. The skirt is full and long, extending outward in a bell shape. The fabric of the dress is light in color, primarily off-white or cream, and is covered in a floral pattern featuring small, scattered flowers in shades of pink, purple, green, and red. The pleats of the skirt and the construction of the dress are detailed with fine lines. At the bottom left corner of the image, the name "LESTER H. KRAUSCH" is written in small capital letters. There are two faint brownish stains near the bottom of the skirt and subtle discoloration in the background, but no other objects are present in the drawing.
title: Dress
